title: Stef's Health Overlay
description: Shows how hurt a creature is with a full-token injury overlay that follows its remaining Stamina (Draw Steel) or hit points (D&D 5e), in five bands from Barely Injured to Mortally Wounded. Stef's Health Overlay is not affiliated with MCDM Productions, LLC. Draw Steel is a trademark of MCDM Productions, LLC.

systems.reason: Overlays follow the creature's Stamina; heroes and retainers below 0 Stamina show Mortally Wounded.
Overlays follow the creature's hit points.
